description: Test files that leave records in the per-pool Vitest approval store (active/shared/runtime/vitest-approvals/run-<id>/pool-<n>/). Regenerated 2026-10-09 over the full root suite (every include in vitest.config.mts: libs, presence, satellites, scripts and tests; Linux, KYBERION_PERSONA=worker MISSION_ROLE=mission_controller). tests/vitest-approval-store-guard.ts clears the store before and after every file, so these leftovers no longer reach other files. A file not listed here fails under KYBERION_TEST_LEAK_STRICT=1. Shrink-only: tests/approval-store-guard-policy.test.ts caps the count and requires every entry to exist; when you add afterEach cleanup to a listed file (the guard prints a note when a listed file left nothing), remove it here and lower the cap.
